notes.title: Chuhou Joutai 2 has been updated, again
notes.notes:
Greetings players.

Even though bug fixes would be released on Tuesdays, we have issued another update for the game. This fix includes making sure the achievements are working as expected, and we are lowering the requirement for the "I Seem OP" achievement from 1,000 to 500 newtons, as some players complained the requirement was too high.

Have a good day in Kozankyo.

notes.title: The game has been updated
notes.notes:
How are you doing on this Tanabata today?

Drillimation Systems on Monday released a new patch for Chuhou Joutai 2. This patch includes a few fixes, including an achievement that could not be unlocked, fixing a text display error in one of Driller's endings in the English version of the game, and you can now take screenshots in-game!

Previously, GameMaker had this option on by default, but then they changed the system so that you have to input a bit of code to enable this feature.

Have fun in Kozan!

notes.title: How are you, players?
notes.notes:
Greetings, players.

24 hours have passed since the release of [i]Chuhou Joutai 2: Paraided![/i]. I would say this was my favorite project I ever worked on. Pre-production began during the early part of 2020 when the coronavirus pandemic locked everyone inside, after [i]Chuhou Joutai 1: The Middle State of War[/i] completed development. Actual development on the sequel began in November 2020 and took seven months to complete. We were proud to announce its completion in May 2021 and celebrate its release yesterday. To those players who are new to the [i]Drillimation Danmaku Universe[/i], welcome. For those who've played the first [i]Chuhou Joutai[/i], welcome back.

We hope you are enjoying the game. We will tweak the game based on player feedback like what we did for the first game. This game was not just intended to be more impressive than the first, but also revolutionary thanks to the new, improved engine we developed. The game's engine was also used in the NES demake version of [i]Touhou 2: The Story of Eastern Wonderland[/i]. Since that game is freeware, you can play this game and really learn how [i]Chuhou Joutai 2[/i] came to be. As always, we truly thank those who were anticipating its completion and release, if you are following us on Twitter and Instagram.

Giving this game a cult following can really help us grow. Please, spread the word on social media, and we will respond to your posts.

Until then, have a good summer.
